answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is by mandating a persistent unique signal from each identity, generated from private context that cannot be shared across a farm. This signal serves as an island of verifiable continuity; at the nadir of collective grading load, the network still demands fresh signal strength, so cloning identities multiplies the private-context cost without amortization. Peers attest only when the signal matches the address history, making mass fakes economically unviable.
